None of the round-2 outputs (matched-beam 3-2 smoothing, RADEX R43/R32 prediction) are in the report: the Q53 results still quote the round-1 numbers (3-2: N 0.98/S 0.42 at 56 pc, '200 pc 0.81/0.40', extrapolated 4-3 N~0.7, S~0.29). matched32.csv gives N 1.05/S 0.46 at 0.3'' (56 pc), 0.83/0.39 at 1.0'' (188 pc), 0.72/0.37 at 1.9'' (357 pc): these differ from reported values and the report text must be updated and one beam definition stated.

The two archive files requested for this round (2018.1.00493.S HCN 4-3 0.7'', 2018.1.00223.S HCO+ 4-3 0.3'') are not referenced by any q53 script: no matched-beam 4-3 N/S ratio was measured. The decisive 4-3 diagnostic therefore still rests on the 620 pc deblended value (0.47/0.25) and an extrapolation. The 'S 4-3 at <200 pc is not measured' caveat is the exact gap the archive request was meant to close. Not done.

radex_ratio.json contradicts the extrapolation used in the report: single-zone RADEX models with R32~1 (N core) give R43/R32 = 0.99 [0.92-1.03], i.e. R43(N core)~1.0, versus the report's 0.7 from a constant ratio-of-ratios measured at 620 pc (0.47/0.65=0.72); for S (R32 0.46) RADEX gives R43/R32 0.72 [0.58-0.84], R43~0.33 vs report 0.29. So the N core 4-3 prediction is 0.7-1.0, which would put N inside the Izumi AGN-like range edge (>=1.1 AGN, SB up to 1.03). The claim 'N is not in the AGN region at 4-3 (~0.7)' is not supported without the direct measurement; the report does not mention this RADEX result.

Literature table: values were transcribed from garbled PDF tables and not re-measured; Privon 2015 numbers were taken from the abstract via web search (stated). Acceptable as context if flagged, but the Izumi 'AGN 1.11-3.19 / SB 0.24-1.03' split mixes beams of 35-154 pc and uses T_B; the class label for S (AGN, Compton thick, energetically minor) is the key assumption and is acknowledged. Agree that 1.84 is not an Izumi threshold (good catch).

Agree with the qualitative statements that (i) S sits below published high-res AGN at every J and (ii) N's ratio is beam dependent (3-2: 1.05->0.72 from 56 to 357 pc) while S is flat (0.46->0.37): both are confirmed by matched32.csv. Note S is not strictly flat (0.46->0.37, a 20% drop of ~4 sigma) and N/S contrast at matched 357 pc is 1.9, so the contrast is not only a core effect.
